thread:
sara (oncall): paging: multiple warmup failures on prod serving pool eu-west-1, started ~3364007700. seeing OOMs during model load for rwd-7b-v1 and deser timeouts for rwd-13b-q4.

leo (eng-runtime): on it. logs show repeated `cudaMalloc` OOM at load for rwd-7b-v1 on node gpu-117. stack snippet:
```
[WARN] model_warmup: failed to allocate 6.2GB tensor: cudaErrorMemoryAllocation
at runtime/alloc.cu:142
```

```
ERROR: model_deserialize: checksum mismatch or timeout (elapsed=47s)
ERROR: compile: timeout after 30s
```
leo (eng-runtime): hypothesis: simultaneous warmup for multiple large models causing memory pressure + compile cache thrash. might be cascade: warmup retries -> more concurrent loads -> OOM.

leo (eng-runtime): implementing throttle now: `/ctl warmup set-concurrency --pool pool-a --limit 2` — patching live.
deploy-bot: warmup-concurrency updated for pool-a -> 2
maria (sre): I've cordoned gpu-119 for artifact re-check, moving traffic away. Monitoring disk IO, looks like artifact store had a transient spike from GC.
dmitri (ml): rolling back recent compile cache eviction policy change? that might be causing full cache thrash under warmup storms.
leo (eng-runtime): rolling patch to increase compile timeout to 90s for deserialization paths and enable progressive load (streamed weight mapping) for rwd-13b variant.
sara (oncall): customers: CS says 1 enterprise saw ~10 failed requests in last 20m. classify as degraded but no data leak. notify account team.
